comment: Assignment groups. Membership of CaC-Tier-Adult/Teen/Child is manually managed in Entra;
this repository never reads or reconciles membership for those groups.
Tier groups (sg-tier-*) are assigned (static) rather than dynamic: dynamic rules would need
attributes we deliberately do not store (age / date of birth), and static membership is far
The 3 device groups (sg-devices-adult/teen/child) use Entra dynamic membership keyed on
administrator-assigned device extensionAttribute1 (Adult, Teen, Child), including Android.
Use Set-CaCDeviceTierTag.ps1 for each new device and Convert-CaCDeviceTierGroupsToDynamic.ps1
to migrate the original assigned groups in place. This repo's
plan/apply engine still never manages their membership directly (memberType: device groups
always resolve to an empty desired member list and NoChange), because Entra now maintains
membership itself; the 'membership' block below is retained only for schema shape.

groups.description: 14-17. Security baseline plus light content controls; apps are blocklisted, not allowlisted.
13 and under. Strictest tier: approved apps only, forced web filtering, tight device controls.
Device group corresponding to the adult tier. Entra dynamic membership matches administrator-assigned device extensionAttribute1 'Adult' across platforms.
Device group corresponding to the teen tier. Entra dynamic membership matches administrator-assigned device extensionAttribute1 'Teen' across platforms.
Device group corresponding to the child tier. Entra dynamic membership matches administrator-assigned device extensionAttribute1 'Child' across platforms, including Android.
Dedicated administrative accounts. Hardened, no productivity workloads.
Every human productivity account. Target for tier-independent security baselines.
Assigned device group populated by Windows Autopilot device preparation for child devices.
Assigned device group populated by Windows Autopilot device preparation for adult devices.
Assigned device group populated by Windows Autopilot device preparation for teen devices.

Whole-family group (adults and kids). Adopted from a pre-existing live group; only ever used for opt-in 'available' app assignments, never required/enforced policies, to avoid impacting the adult accounts.
Firecall accounts. Exclusion target only - never assign a policy to this group.
